summary: Asks whether stale mutable state fallback logic in ndc_task_util.go can be safely removed based on StaleMutableStateCounter metric monitoring in production.
userImpact: Removing unnecessary fallback logic could reduce server complexity, but incorrect removal could introduce data consistency issues.
proposedFix: Monitor StaleMutableStateCounter metric to confirm fallback is no longer needed; remove stale mutable state fallback logic if metric remains near-zero for sufficient period.
keyQuote: We should monitor the StaleMutableStateCounter metric and remove the logic below once we are confident.
